title: Their #9 is yours
brief: Their #8 is about to slip the ball out to their winger. Keep an eye on their #9.
briefKid: Their midfielder is about to pass out wide. Watch their striker too.
question: The ball is out wide and their #9 is running into the box. Where do you go?
questionKid: Ball out wide, their striker running in. Where do you go?

takeaway.standard: When the ball goes wide, your job is their #9: drop with your line and stand between them and the middle of our goal, leaning a little toward the ball.
takeaway.kid: When the ball goes wide, stay between their striker and our goal.

misconceptions.text: You drifted toward the ball, but your full-back and your partner have it covered; their #9 is your job.
misconceptions.textKid: Your teammates are going to the ball, so watch their striker.

misconceptions.text: You stayed in front of their #9, so a ball played in behind you finds them free in the box.
misconceptions.textKid: Get between their striker and our goal, not in front of them.
